Third-party software notices for cinema-tv

Original cinema-tv code and artwork: owner approval remains pending; no project license grant is made by this file.

The resolved runtime component inventory, archive SHA-256 values, source notices and APK-presence evidence are in docs/evidence/component-inventory.json.
Build tools and test-only JUnit/Hamcrest are inventoried separately and are not shipped as runtime dependencies.

Runtime libraries are predominantly Apache-2.0. AndroidX DataStore external protobuf carries BSD-3-Clause.
Kotlin stdlib also incorporates ThreeTenBP (BSD-3-Clause) and Boost-licensed math code; their upstream license texts are included below.
Boost-derived math attribution as recorded by the Kotlin upstream index: Copyright Eric Ford & Hubert Holin 2001.
Kotlin upstream evidence: https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/blob/v2.4.20/license/README.md
